latest_release.name: v53.5.6
latest_release.body:
## `@platejs/yjs`

### Patch Changes

- [#5338](https://github.com/udecode/plate/pull/5338) by [@yulman2207](https://github.com/yulman2207) –
  - Accept `@hocuspocus/provider` v4 in the peer dependency range, so installing it no longer warns about an unmet peer.

## Contributors

Thanks to everyone who contributed to this release:

@yulman2207

Full changelog: [`v53.5.5...v53.5.6`](https://github.com/udecode/plate/compare/v53.5.5...v53.5.6)

hot_issues.title: Yjs: useEditorSelection() does not seem to work with YjsPlugin
[Bug]: Font colour toolbar component has fragile dropdown sizing
[Bug]: Table: clicks on unmapped DOM regions desync selection and crash toSlateRange on typing/paste
Plate.js: our measured DOCX round-trip result, and an invitation to correct it in a pull request
[Bug]: deserializeMd keeps `\r` at the end of code-block lines for CRLF input, and serializeMd writes mixed line endings inside the fence
Markdown deserializer drops the whitespace before a CommonMark email autolink (`<name@host>`) and before any incomplete tag it recovers from
[Bug]: deserializeMd drops a soft line break that follows an inline node, merging the words around it
applyAISuggestions (AI edit in "chat" mode) crashes or corrupts the document while it streams

detail.readme:
Plate

[//]: # ' ' [//]: # 'Welcome to Plate, a rich-text editor framework designed for simplicity and efficiency. Plate consists of four main parts:' [//]: # [//]: # "1. **Core**: This is the heart of Plate. It's a special plugin system just for `slate-react`. We've made sure everything is neat and tidy, so it's easier for you to develop your project." [//]: # '2. **Plugins**: We give you a big selection of plugin packages. They help make editor behaviors, hooks, serialization, and normalization better, among other things.' [//]: # '3. **Primitives**: Besides the headless plugins, we also provide primitive hooks and components built on top of [Radix UI](https://www.radix-ui.com/). These are **unstyled** and accessible parts for making great design systems.' [//]: # '4. **Components**: We know a good-looking start is important. So, we give you components created with Plate CLI and [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/). Use these as a starting point to create your own component library.' ## Templates You can choose one of the following templates to get started: | Option | Plate | Plugins | AI | Backend | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [Notion-like template](https://pro.platejs.org/docs/templates/potion) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | [Plate playground template](https://github.com/udecode/plate-playground-template) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | | [Plate minimal template](https://github.com/udecode/plate-template) | ✅ | | | | ## Documentation You can learn more about Plate by checking out our [documentation](https://platejs.org/docs). ## Contributing Found a bug or want a feature? File an issue with a reproduction. The team writes every fix, as the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) explains. ### Contributors We'd love for you to join us! Whether it's through giving us a 🌟 star, filing an 🐛 issue with a reproduction, or **sharing your plugins**, your help is always appreciated. [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=udecode/plate&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#udecode/plate&Date) Need more help? Join us on [Discord](https://discord.gg/mAZRuBzGM3). We're always here to guide you. ## 中文文档 您可以通过查看我们的[中文文档](tooling/cn/README.md)了解更多关于Plate的信息。如果您需要中文支持，欢迎加入我们的[Discord](https://discord.gg/mAZRuBzGM3)中文频道，我们的社区成员将很乐意用中文为您解答问题。 对于贡献者，我们也提供了[中文贡献指南](tooling/cn/CONTRIBUTING.md)，帮助您参与到Plate的开发中。
